limitations: Software rendering establishes shader compilation and fixture parity, not physical-device FPS or GPU timing.
Full production shader fixtures bind deterministic synthetic textures; original texture art and full-world traversal are not covered.

Compatibility full spatial references restore the original varying layout. Vulkan cannot compile that over-budget original layout; terrain references restore original normal/coast values within the hardware limit. Vulkan cave scenes verify production compilation, visibility and influence while independent payload tests verify all 68 input lanes.
Numerical GPU height generation remains the existing validated grassland path. Other surface height generators and cave topology retain canonical CPU implementations.
The comprehensive 3504-point numerical sampler is not claimed on Mobile; existing CI records its separate software compiler limit.
The complete legacy suite, including general and coast modes, and uninterrupted full-world traversal were not revalidated in this focused run.
Timings from concurrent/compilation-heavy runs are diagnostic and do not establish a CPU speedup.
